Leah (AE): Quick thread to align on the OrionHealth POC scope — they want streaming + function/tool calls that return strict JSON (no markup), plus a reserved-capacity estimate and security questionnaire responses.
Sam (Presales): Summarizing their asks: 1) live stream (WS preferred) with tool calls, 2) function outputs must conform to a JSON schema we can validate, 3) short-lived credentials for their connector, 4) latency target ~120ms p50 for ~500-token responses, 5) on-prem or VPC option for PHI.
Marta (Customer): Correct. We'll only accept embeddings if stored in our VPC; otherwise no external persistence. Also need to see KMS options and an audit log sample.
Ravi (SDK Eng): We can demonstrate with Python and Go SDKs. Minimal WebSocket handshake example (Python):
```python
from redwood import Client, Stream
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
stream = client.ws_stream(model="rwd-med-1", prompt="extract_conditions")
for msg in stream:
    if msg.type == "tool_call":
        # tool payload is guaranteed to be JSON when using function schema
        handle_tool(json.loads(msg.payload))
```
We'll surface validation events when outputs don't match the schema.
Sam (Presales): Proposed POC phases: Stage A (2 days) hosted sandbox to validate stream+schema; Stage B (5 days) Dedicated trial in EU for perf tests; Stage C (optional) Private on-prem eval. Keep scope to two function calls and one schema.
Leah (AE): Marta also asked for a ballpark for reserved capacity: estimate for ~300 qps peak, ~80 qps avg, baseline 2-rack capacity. Any quick numbers?
Ravi (SDK Eng): Ballpark: Dedicated footprint equivalent to 2 A40-ish GPUs (with room for KV cache) — estimate $13k–$20k/month depending on model quantization and batching. If they need enterprise-grade on-prem packaging with HSM integration add a one-time engagement fee. We'll provide a more exact quote after token histogram.
Jules (Security): For the SQ: we can provide SOC2 attestation, data-in-transit TLS 1.2+, at-rest AES-256 with KMS, key rotation details, and a responsibility matrix for on-prem. Need the actual questionnaire file (PDF/CSV) to map answers. Also clarify logging retention window and whether logs can be pushed to their SIEM.
Marta (Customer): We'll upload the SQ this afternoon. For logs, they must be exportable into our SIEM; retention 365 days.
Ravi (SDK Eng): Sample JSON schema we'll use for validation: 
```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "record_id": {"type": "string"},
    "conditions": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"code": {"type": "string"}, "description": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["code"]}}
  },
  "required": ["record_id", "conditions"]
}
```
We'll run client-side and server-side validation; stream will emit a validation_failed event with details.
Sam (Presales): Action items: Leah — collect SQ + contract constraints; Ravi — prepare two demo artifacts (hosted stream app + Dedicated perf script); Jules — draft SQ answers and on-prem responsibilities; Pricing ops — draft two price paths (short Dedicated trial and Private onboard).
Leah (AE): I'll upload the SQ and send calendar invites for a 30-min tech kickoff with Marta + infra lead tomorrow 10am CET.
RedwoodBot: Sandbox deploy rwd-sandbox-22 completed — sample stream app: https://sandbox.redwood.local/streams/orion-demo
Marta (Customer): Thanks. One more question: do you support short-lived OIDC tokens for connectors?
Ravi (SDK Eng): Yes — we support ephemeral tokens via our credential broker and can issue scoped tokens for the POC. We'll include an example in the demo repo.
Jules (Security): We'll include a sample dataflow diagram and an exportable logging policy in the answers pack. For Private deployments we note HSM/KMS integration points and audit log endpoints.
Sam (Presales): Keep scope razor-focused: streaming handshake + two function calls with schema'd JSON and confirmation of creds + encryption. Anything else is out of scope for the initial POC.
Leah (AE): Agreed. I'll follow up after I post the SQ. :thumbsup:
